raw.head: PersonX lacks interest in anything
raw.literal: Lavar lacks interest in anything because Lavar wants to be indifferent.
raw.narrative: Lavar is bored with his life and wants to be indifferent. He has no goals or ambitions and finds everything uninteresting. Even his hobbies are lacklustre and unfulfilling.
dialogue: I don't know, man. I just feel like there's nothing to look forward to. Everything is so boring.
What do you mean? You have plenty of hobbies and interests.
Yeah, but they're all so pointless. I don't care about anything anymore.
That's not true. You used to be really passionate about your hobbies. What happened?
I don't know...I guess I just grew out of them. Nothing seems fun or exciting anymore. Even my job is unfulfilling.
Well, maybe you just need some time to figure out what you want in life. Have you given any thought to what you might want to do with your future?
Not really...I'm not sure what I want to do with my life. I don't have any goals or ambitions anymore. Everything seems so pointless.
